stories.headline: FDA approves Otsuka's sibeprenlimab (Voyxact) for IgA nephropathy after 51% proteinuria cut

key_facts.fact: The FDA approved sibeprenlimab-szsi (Voyxact; Otsuka) to reduce proteinuria in adults with IgA nephropathy, based on interim Phase 3 VISIONARY trial data
key_facts.excerpt: The FDA has approved sibeprenlimab-szsi (Voyxact; Otsuka) to reduce proteinuria in adults who have immunoglobulin A nephropathy(IgAN), based on an interim analysis of data from the phase 3 VISIONARY trial

key_facts.fact: Treatment is a 400 mg subcutaneous self-injection via prefilled syringe every 4 weeks at home
key_facts.excerpt: Administration is via a prefilled syringe for subcutaneous self-injection every 4 weeks at home. The recommended single dose is 400 mg

key_facts.fact: VISIONARY trial showed a 51.2% reduction in proteinuria vs placebo at 9 months (p<0.0001); 510 patients enrolled across the cohort
key_facts.excerpt: Data used to support this approval show a 9-month proteinuria reduction of 50% vs 2% in those who received placebo... A prespecified interim analysis of VISIONARY data... showing a 51.2% reduction (P < .0001) in proteinuria

key_facts.fact: Safety profile showed 76.3% of treated patients experienced any treatment-emergent adverse event vs 84.5% on placebo; serious AE rates were 3.9% vs 5.4%
key_facts.excerpt: Safety data also were positive, showing 76.3% of treated patients compared with 84.5% of patients who received placebo experienced any treatment-emergent adverse event (AE), with serious AE rates of 3.9% and 5.4%, respectively

key_facts.fact: A confirmatory trial is still needed to determine if sibeprenlimab can slow kidney function decline at 24 months for ongoing approval
key_facts.excerpt: A confirmatory trial is still needed to determine if sibeprenlimab can slow kidney function decline over the long term (ie, at 24 months), as well as for ongoing approval of this new indication

stories.headline: Microsoft launches MAI-Thinking-1 reasoning model, trained from scratch with zero distillation

key_facts.fact: MAI-Thinking-1 is a 35B-active / 1T-total parameter MoE reasoning model with a 256K-token context window, unveiled at Microsoft Build 2026 on June 2.
key_facts.excerpt: Today we are introducing MAI-Thinking-1, Microsoft AI's reasoning model. It is a medium-sized model that stands among the strongest models in its weight class... 35B active, ~1T total parameters, MoE... 256k token window.

key_facts.fact: The model scored 52.8% on SWE-Bench Pro, 97.0% on AIME 2025 and 87.7% on LiveCodeBench v6 according to Microsoft's technical report.
key_facts.excerpt: MAI-Thinking-1, a 35B active / 1T total parameter MoE that stands among the strongest models of similar size on STEM reasoning and coding tasks (e.g., 52.8% on SWE-Bench Pro, 97.0% on AIME 2025, and 87.7% on LiveCodeBench v6).

key_facts.fact: Microsoft trained the model on 30 trillion tokens on 8K GB200 GPUs without distillation from third-party models, excluding AI-generated content from pre-training.
key_facts.excerpt: pre trained from scratch on 8K GB200 GPUs on a Microsoft-operated cluster within the Azure platform... we ran a main pre-training phase of 30 trillion tokens... free of any distillation data.

key_facts.fact: Microsoft says independent human raters on Surge prefer MAI-Thinking-1 to Claude Sonnet 4.6 in blind side-by-side evaluations, and the model matches Claude Opus 4.6 on SWE-Bench Pro.
key_facts.excerpt: Independent human raters on Surge prefer MAI-Thinking-1 for overall quality in blind side-by-sides to Sonnet 4.6 across single and multi-turn tasks... competitive with Claude Opus 4.6 on SWE-Bench Pro.

key_facts.fact: MAI-Thinking-1 is part of a family of seven new in-house models released at Build, including MAI-Image-2.5 and MAI-Code-1-Flash.
key_facts.excerpt: the Microsoft AI Superintelligence Team released a family of seven new in-house models, starting with MAI-Thinking-1– Microsoft AI's first reasoning model. Trained from scratch with zero distillation on enterprise grade, clean and commercially licensed data.

stories.headline: SpaceX targets record $75B IPO at $135 per share, $1.75T valuation

key_facts.fact: SpaceX plans to sell 555.6 million shares at $135 each to raise $75 billion, an unusual move that fixes a price before the investor roadshow
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX plans to raise $75 billion in its initial public offering by selling 555.6 million shares at a target price of $135 per share

key_facts.fact: Target valuation is $1.75 trillion in what would be the largest IPO in history; the offering is structured as all-primary with no insider sales
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX, Elon Musk's rocket and satellite company, plans to target a valuation of $1.75 trillion in its blockbuster initial public offering, which will consist entirely of new shares

key_facts.fact: Roadshow begins Thursday June 4; SpaceX aims to debut on Nasdaq under ticker SPCX as early as June 12
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX's roadshow begins on Thursday... SpaceX is aiming to trade on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol 'SPCX.' The debut is expected on June 12

key_facts.fact: Musk will be required to hold his SpaceX shares for 366 days after the IPO under a lockup; greenshoe option set at 15%
key_facts.excerpt: Musk will be required to hold his SpaceX shares for 366 days after the IPO, one of the sources said, a signal to investors of his commitment to the company

key_facts.fact: Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, BofA Securities, Citigroup and JPMorgan are joint book-running managers
key_facts.excerpt: Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, BofA Securities, Citigroup and J.P. Morgan are the joint book-running managers for the offering

stories.headline: AI music startup Suno raises $400M at $5.4B valuation, led by Bond Capital

key_facts.fact: Suno raised $400 million at a $5.4 billion valuation, with Bond Capital leading the round alongside IVP, Forerunner and Union Square Ventures; existing backers Lightspeed and Menlo Ventures also participated.
key_facts.excerpt: Suno Inc., a startup that enables people to make music using artificial intelligence, has raised $400 million at a valuation of $5.4 billion. Bond Capital, which has invested in OpenAI and Kalshi, is leading the round alongside venture capital firms such as IVP, Forerunner and Union Square Ventures.

key_facts.fact: The valuation more than doubled from the $2.45 billion mark set in Suno's November 2025 Series C, which raised $250 million.
key_facts.excerpt: The company's valuation has doubled since its $250 million funding round seven months ago. The latest investment makes Suno the highest-valued company among AI music startups.

key_facts.fact: Suno passed 2 million paid subscribers in February 2026 and is tracking toward $300 million in annual revenue.
key_facts.excerpt: Suno passed 2 million subscribers in February and is tracking toward $300 million in annual revenue.

key_facts.fact: The startup employs about 200 people and plans to grow headcount by up to 70% before year-end, per co-founder and CEO Mikey Shulman.
key_facts.excerpt: The company currently employs about 200 people and aims to grow its workforce by up to 70% before the end of the year.

stories.headline: Trump signs scaled-back AI executive order focused on cybersecurity and voluntary review

key_facts.fact: President Trump signed an executive order on June 2, 2026 establishing a voluntary framework for evaluating advanced AI models with significant cybersecurity capabilities, rejecting mandatory licensing or preclearance.
key_facts.excerpt: U.S. President Donald Trump signed Tuesday an executive order establishing a voluntary framework for evaluating advanced artificial intelligence models with significant cybersecurity capabilities in a directive that rejects mandatory licensing or preclearance requirements.

key_facts.fact: The order shortens the federal pre-deployment review window for covered frontier models from 90 days in earlier drafts to up to 30 days.
key_facts.excerpt: AI companies would voluntarily provide the federal government access to frontier models before release, but now it will be for 'up to' 30 days instead of the 90-day timeline included in previous drafts.

key_facts.fact: The order directs Treasury, NSA and CISA to develop classified benchmarks to assess advanced cyber capabilities of AI systems and identify 'covered frontier models'.
key_facts.excerpt: A key component of the order directs the Department of the Treasury, National Security Agency and Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency to develop and maintain a classified benchmarking process for assessing the advanced cyber capabilities of AI systems.

key_facts.fact: It also establishes an AI cybersecurity clearinghouse coordinating vulnerability scanning and patching with industry and critical infrastructure operators in voluntary collaboration.
key_facts.excerpt: the Secretary of the Treasury... shall form an AI cybersecurity clearinghouse, in voluntary collaboration with the AI industry and operators of critical infrastructure, that coordinates and deconflicts scanning for software vulnerabilities, discovers and validates such vulnerabilities, and coordinates and prioritizes remediation and distribution of vulnerability patches.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman publicly backed the order, saying it 'gets the balance right' between developing the best models and getting cyber tools into defenders' hands.
key_facts.excerpt: @sama: the US should lead on AI by continuing to develop the very best models, making sure they're safe, and getting cyber tools into the hands of trusted defenders. the new EO gets the balance right.

stories.headline: US sanctions Nobitex and three other Iranian crypto exchanges over IRGC links

key_facts.fact: The US Treasury's OFAC designated Nobitex, Wallex, Bitpin and Ramzinex on June 2 for facilitating terrorist financing and sanctions evasion
key_facts.excerpt: The Treasury's Office of Foreign Asset Control announced that Nobitex, Wallex, Bitpin and Ramzinex, as well as some of these exchanges' executives, were being added to its global Specially Designated Nationals list

key_facts.fact: Treasury alleges Nobitex processed more than 50% of all Iranian digital asset inflows in 2025 and facilitated IRGC-linked transactions including ransomware payments
key_facts.excerpt: The Treasury Department alleges Nobitex processed more than 50% of all Iranian digital asset inflows in 2025 and facilitated payments tied to Iran's terrorist activities, sanctions evasion efforts, and Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps-linked transactions

key_facts.fact: Nobitex handled roughly $5 billion in transactions from 2025 to March 2026, per TRM Labs
key_facts.excerpt: Nobitex handled roughly US$5 billion (S$6.4 billion) in transactions from 2025 to March 2026, according to TRM Labs

key_facts.fact: Treasury also sanctioned Nobitex's three co-founders and current CEO; Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said his department has seized roughly $1 billion in crypto from Iranian wallets since the war began
key_facts.excerpt: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that his department had seized around $1 billion in crypto from Iranian exchanges and wallets since the beginning of the war against Iran

key_facts.fact: Treasury alleges Nobitex helped Iran move assets out of the country after US bombing began and aided the Central Bank of Iran in accessing stablecoins to prop up the rial
key_facts.excerpt: [Nobitex] also helped the Central Bank of Iran access hundreds of millions of dollars in stablecoins used to prop up the plummeting value of the Iranian rial

stories.headline: Vingroup commits $12.75M to Vinmotion USA humanoid robotics R&D arm

key_facts.fact: Vingroup's board approved a $12.75M investment in Vinmotion USA, Inc., a humanoid robot and AI research subsidiary, with the resolution dated May 29 and disclosure on June 2.
key_facts.excerpt: Vingroup has approved a $12.75 million investment in a US-based humanoid robot and AI technology research company... On May 29, the group's board of directors issued a resolution approving the acquisition of shares in Vinmotion USA, Inc.

key_facts.fact: Plans include building a US R&D center to attract global talent and partner with universities, research institutes and tech firms.
key_facts.excerpt: the company will research and develop humanoid robotic products and technology solutions. It also plans to establish a research and development centre in the US to attract global talents and collaborate with universities, research institutions, and leading advanced technology partners worldwide.

key_facts.fact: Vinmotion USA is being acquired from VinMotion General Purpose Humanoid Robots Application, Development and Research JSC, a Vingroup subsidiary spun up to focus on general-purpose humanoid robots.
key_facts.excerpt: The group's board of directors issued a resolution approving the acquisition of shares in Vinmotion USA, Inc. from VinMotion General Purpose Humanoid Robots Application, Development and Research JSC, a Vingroup subsidiary.

stories.headline: ZutaCore raises $100M Series C at ~$600M valuation for direct-to-chip AI data center cooling

key_facts.fact: Israeli direct-to-chip liquid cooling startup ZutaCore closed a $100M Series C led by Mitsubishi Electric, Carrier and Samsung Ventures, announced on June 2.
key_facts.excerpt: Israeli company ZutaCore... has announced the completion of a $100 million Series C funding round. The round was led by global industrial and technology groups Mitsubishi Electric, Carrier, and Samsung Electronics, through its investment arm Samsung Ventures.

key_facts.fact: The round values ZutaCore at about $600M and brings total funding to roughly $200M since founding, per Calcalist.
key_facts.excerpt: ZutaCore is currently valued at close to $600 million, according to Calcalist estimates... The latest financing brings ZutaCore's total funding since its founding to approximately $200 million.

key_facts.fact: ZutaCore says its waterless two-phase cooling has been deployed at over 75 sites in North America, Europe and Asia, with partnerships across semiconductor and computing firms.
key_facts.excerpt: The company says its technology has already been deployed at more than 75 sites across North America, Europe, and Asia. It also maintains partnerships with major semiconductor and computing companies.

key_facts.fact: Capital will go to scaling commercial sales and expanding capacity to meet AI/HPC infrastructure demand.
key_facts.excerpt: The capital will be used to accelerate the company's global commercialization efforts, expand its sales network, and meet rapidly growing demand for AI and high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure.

sources.title: Israeli AI cooling startup ZutaCore raises $100 million Series C at estimated $600 million valuation
